Subject: POC plan & timeline — Optivex evaluation (post-call recap)

Hi Rajesh / Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

Call highlights
- Goal: 6-week POC to validate Redwood inference for Optivex’s customer-facing summarization flows (multi-document, retain context across sessions).
- Success criteria (high level): 1) 95th percentile latency <= 400ms for single-user interactive sessions, 2) model quality aligned with current baseline (ROUGE-L within 3 points on the provided eval set), 3) end-to-end cost target <= $X per 1M tokens, 4) secure handling of customer PII and audit logs for requests.

Proposed evaluation plan / milestones
1) Kickoff (week 0): confirm scope, sign POC SOW, grant Redwood access to sample data and test environment.
2) Week 1: integration + baseline run (connect API, run baseline prompts from Optivex test set).
3) Weeks 2–4: iterative tuning (batching, quantization profile, prompt engineering). Weekly check-ins.
4) Week 5: full-scale run on 10k session sample, collect metrics and qualitative feedback.
5) Week 6: final readout, decision meeting (go/no-go + next steps).

Ownership
- Marissa (me): commercial coordination, SOW and timelines.
- Aisha: solution architecture + model tuning, weekly tech check-ins.
- Rishi: infra/sre support for dedicated test capacity and monitoring.
- Laura: success criteria validation and final readout coordination.

Attachments: I’ve attached a draft POC_SOW and a simple test-plan spreadsheet to make timelines and deliverables concrete.

Immediate next steps (proposed)
- Rajesh: review SOW and confirm scope/any changes by EOD Friday (2026-02-20).
- Optivex: provide sample prompts and a redacted sample dataset (S3 link preferred) within 3 business days of SOW sign.
- Redwood: once SOW is signed, we’ll schedule the kickoff for the week of 2026-02-22.

If that all looks good I’ll send a calendar invite for the kickoff and the weekly check-ins.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.example.com
+1 415-555-0123

Date: 2026-02-18T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC plan & timeline — Optivex evaluation (post-call recap)

Thanks Marissa — this looks great and matches what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Success criteria: we agree on 95th <= 400ms, but we may need to allow a short warmup period for KV cache to stabilize; can we capture both cold and warmed metrics?
- Quality target: instead of absolute ROUGE delta, can we do a combined qualitative rubric (business stakeholders + 100-sample blind eval) and check against current prod performance?
- Security: we require SOC2 Type II evidence and an encrypted S3 transfer for sample data.

We’ll review the SOW and aim to return redlines by EOD 2026-02-20. Priya will send the redacted sample dataset S3 link by 2026-02-22 if SOW is signed.

Happy to proceed with kickoff the week of 2026-02-22 — prefer Tue/Wed mornings PT.

Rajesh
Director of Product — Optivex
rajesh@optivex.com
